description: DSv4-Flash ds4 engine lane: union of the GGUF k-quant/IQ menu and the OCP MX microscaling formats the engine decodes natively (MXFP4 routed experts are the checkpoint's own grid; MXFP6/MXFP8 are group-32 E8M0 re-encodes). BF16 is the unquantized passthrough.

format_rules.detail: ds4 union menu: ggml tensor types (K-quants Q2_K..Q6_K, Q8_0, IQ2 family) plus OCP MX group-32 formats (MXFP4/MXFP6_E2M3/MXFP6_E3M2/MXFP8_E4M3) and BF16 passthrough; everything else is structurally unavailable in the engine

shape_rules.detail: GGUF k-quants and 256-superblock IQ types pack 256-element superblocks along the input dim
Q8_0 packs 32-element blocks along the input dim
OCP MX formats scale 32-element groups (E8M0 per-group scale) along the input dim
